producer_report.summary: Admission now judges a changed athena.toml by the candidate's own Config schema when the candidate changes crates/athena-data/src/config.rs. It builds that file in a temporary crate and fails closed. With no schema change it parses with the running Config as before. The three tests the send-back named were already in place; I re-ran them and they pass. I also re-ran the full `cargo test --locked`. I did not run clippy or fmt again in this pass.

checks_run.note: Ran to completion. I did not read the full output, which was truncated; the three admission tests and the six existing ones passed in the targeted run.

criteria_check.criterion: A new admission test shows a candidate that adds a new `[section]` to athena.toml together with the matching field in athena-data's Config is admitted with no 'configuration' violation. Run `cargo test -p athena-core admission`.
criteria_check.evidence: Test a_new_section_and_its_schema_field_together_are_admitted in admission.rs adds [parallel] to athena.toml and a matching field in config.rs. It first asserts the running Config rejects the text with 'unknown field `parallel`', then asserts no configuration violation. It passes in `cargo test --locked -p athena-core admission` (9 passed).

criteria_check.criterion: A new admission test shows a candidate that adds an unknown `[section]` to athena.toml without changing the schema is still refused with a 'configuration' violation naming the unknown field. Run `cargo test -p athena-core admission`.
criteria_check.evidence: Test an_unknown_section_without_a_schema_change_is_still_refused_by_the_candidate_schema adds [bogus]. It asserts exactly one configuration violation whose detail contains 'unknown field `bogus`', both when config.rs is touched only by a comment (checked by the candidate's schema) and when config.rs is untouched. It passes.

criteria_check.criterion: A test shows that when the candidate's own schema check cannot run or fails, admission reports a 'configuration' violation instead of passing. Run `cargo test -p athena-core admission`.
criteria_check.evidence: Test a_candidate_schema_check_that_cannot_run_is_a_configuration_violation gives a config.rs that does not compile. It asserts one configuration violation whose detail contains 'does not parse' and 'error'. It passes.
